Centre for Deaf and Hard of Hearing People (CfD)

A community-based charity providing equipment assessments, resource rooms, BSL support, and weekly community groups in Bristol.

  • devices Equipment Line: 0345 900 7830
  • sms SMS / WhatsApp: 07545 264 840

Bristol City Council – Sensory Support (Adults)

Provides advice, rehabilitation, equipment referrals, and Care Act assessments for Deaf and hard-of-hearing adults across Bristol.

📅 Weekly Drop-in Sessions:

Wednesdays (1:30–3:30 pm): CfD Vassall Centre (BS16 2QQ)

Fridays (1:30–3:30 pm): Bedminster Library (BS3 4AQ)

  • mail Email: sensory.impairment@bristol.gov.uk
  • sms SMS: 07775 646 671
  • videocam Video Support: Zoom appointments available for BSL users
open_in_new Visit Bristol Council Portal

Hearing Impaired Support Scheme (HISS Bristol)

A Bristol registered charity working in partnership with UHBW NHS Audiology. Trained volunteers (many who use hearing aids themselves) provide home visits for elderly or housebound NHS hearing aid users to assist with retubing, cleaning, battery supply, and advice.

🏠 Home Visit Maintenance & Referral:

Provides free home visits for UHBW NHS hearing aid users unable to attend clinic due to mobility, age, or disability.

  • call Referral: Contact UHBW Audiology for HISS referral
  • home Services: Free Home Tube Replacement, Cleaning & Battery Support
open_in_new Visit HISS Bristol Website

UHBW NHS Audiology – Postal Batteries & Tubing

Official online request form for patients issued NHS hearing aids by University Hospitals Bristol and Weston NHS Trust (UHBW). Request replacement batteries, mould tubing, thin tubes, domes, and cleaning wires sent directly to your home.

📦 Postal Delivery Details:

Free 2nd Class Delivery: Aimed within 2 weeks of request. Supplies include P13 (Orange), 312 (Brown), 675 (Blue) batteries, mould tubing, and slim tubes/domes.

  • local_shipping Service: Free Royal Mail delivery for registered NHS patients
  • mail Email: Audiology.Dept@uhbw.nhs.uk
  • info Guidance: Please only order batteries when running low to protect NHS resources

Sensory Support Service (Children & Families)

Education-focused specialist support for children and young people with hearing loss. Host of the Acorns Early Years Group (ages 0–5).

  • call Phone: 0117 903 8441 / 8442 / 8443
  • location_on Address: Elmfield House, Greystoke Ave, Westbury-on-Trym, Bristol BS10 6AY
